An outstanding jazz score highlights this tale of two American musicians in Paris whose lives are changed by tourists.
programme.title: Paris Blues

programme.desc: A pet deer changes a boy (Claude Jarman Jr.) and his parents (Gregory Peck, Jane Wyman), pioneering farmers in Florida after the Civil War.
programme.title: The Yearling

programme.desc: A naughty little girl (Shirley Temple) dreams she and her brother are sent by a fairy to find the bluebird of happiness.
programme.title: The Blue Bird

programme.desc: A detective (Peter O'Toole) helps a French art forger's daughter (Audrey Hepburn) steal a fake Venus.
programme.title: How to Steal a Million

programme.desc: International swindlers are diverted from their sinister dealings when an explosion wrecks the ship they are aboard.
programme.title: Beat the Devil

programme.desc: An avenger's (Richard Harrison) quest in the name of his father leads from Mexico to a duel in Texas.
programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands

programme.desc: Two Wild West con men (John Astin, Steve Carlson) ride into a Colorado town, unaware it sits on a fortune in ore.
programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole

programme.desc: Queen Elizabeth I (Flora Robson) sends a naval spy (Laurence Olivier) to the court of Philip of Spain, whose armada he attacks.
programme.title: Fire Over England

programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.
programme.title: Belle Starr

programme.desc: In a moment of desperation, the township of Hamlin hires a stranger to rid the town of rats forever, but when the townsfolk refuse to pay him, he vows revenge.
programme.title: The Pied Piper of Hamlin

programme.desc: A burlesque queen's (Adele Jergens) chorus-girl daughter (Marilyn Monroe) falls in love with a society man (Rand Brooks).
programme.title: Ladies of the Chorus

programme.desc: Jelly from Venus turns into the Ymir, a tailed creature that keeps growing and ends up on the loose in Rome.
programme.title: 20 Million Miles to Earth

programme.desc: Slapstick comedy from Larry, Moe, Curly and occasionally Shemp.
programme.title: The Three Stooges

programme.desc: The Mexican rebel (Telly Savalas) and his right-hand man (Clint Walker) lead an attack on a U.S. fort.
programme.title: Pancho Villa

programme.desc: In a society where life ends at age 30, a law enforcement officer known as a Sandman (Michael York) flees with another 30-year-old (Jenny Agutter) when he learns his number has come up prematurely.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: Long-nosed Cyrano de Begerac helps an army officer woo Roxane, despite his own feelings for her.
programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac

programme.desc: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.
programme.title: Ocean's Eleven

programme.desc: Two vaudeville guys (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) turn deep-sea divers and save a treasure belonging to a Polynesian princess (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Bali

programme.desc: The girl (Glynnis O'Connor) next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.
programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble

programme.desc: Private eye Mike Hammer (Mickey Spillane) asks a bikinied blonde (Shirley Eaton) and others about his long-lost secretary, Velda.
programme.title: The Girl Hunters

programme.desc: An elderly man and his sister harbor a secret about an abandoned farmhouse hidden in the deep woods, concealed from their adopted teenage daughter.
programme.title: The Red House

programme.desc: A gruff neighbor (Lee Marvin) and a newspaper editor (Gary Merrill) help a teenage farmer (Brandon de Wilde) grow up in circa-1910 Missouri.
programme.title: The Missouri Traveler

programme.desc: Newlyweds (Lucille Ball, Desi Arnaz) splurge on a trailer for their honeymoon, which includes Yosemite National Park.
programme.title: The Long, Long Trailer

programme.desc: Animators Max and Dave Fleischer's adaptation of Jonathan Swift's classic about a shipwrecked Englishman in Lilliput.
programme.title: Gulliver's Travels

programme.desc: S02 E11 — The Trail Gang An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.
programme.title: Bonanza

programme.desc: Bumpkins Moe, Larry and Curly Joe (The Three Stooges) help an ice-skating Snow White (Carol Heiss) find her Prince Charming (Edson Stroll).
programme.title: Snow White and the Three Stooges

programme.desc: A playboy novelist's (Kirk Douglas) most businesslike secretary (Laraine Day) becomes his wife and literary rival.
programme.title: My Dear Secretary

programme.desc: Railway police take action when kidnappers choose their busy station as the drop-off point for their ransom money.
programme.title: Union Station
